Name: Luny's Cottagecore Shirts for Fashion Sense
Author: LooneyLuny
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/3Ffvnd3.png[/img]﻿
[center]Finally finished this enough to post it! \(￣▽￣*)/ I'll probably make a few edits here and there, but I believe it's finally done!
This mod adds 3 variations of a button-down shirt + suspenders to fashion sense.

variation 1 - Untucked button-down shirt with no suspenders.
variation 2 - Half tucked button-down shirt with a single suspender.
variation 3 - Tucked button-down shirt with both suspenders.

The shirt and suspenders can be colored separately for whatever color combo you want to use.
The sleeves are a separate piece found in the "Sleeves" category of FS. They can be colored separately, or you can copy the color of the shirt to have them match.

If you notice any issues, leave a comment and I'll look into it. ^-^

The area shown in the background of image 1 is the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/31534]Breezy Bluffs Farm v2[/url]﻿ by windvalley. Loving that map so far! ♡


[img]https://i.imgur.com/B92L7co.png[/img]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url]﻿﻿!
Unzip the file, then place the folder "[FS] Luny's Cottagecore Shirts" into your StardewValley/mods folder. Done!



[img]https://i.imgur.com/Sii0Iov.gif[/img]﻿[/center][center]
